content: LangGraph implements multi-agent handoffs via handoff tools that return Command objects (goto=target, graph=Command.PARENT) which update parent graph state and route control flow. Supervisor pattern = central orchestrator picks worker each turn (more overhead, more control). Swarm pattern = decentralized, agents hand off directly to each other (faster, less control). Every handoff tool must return a ToolMessage with matching tool_call_id or history becomes malformed - this IS the acknowledgment mechanism in LangGraph's message protocol.
